question: Why is Kanya island considered the supreme land of action?
premises: Kanya island contains great variety in classes, stages of life, conduct, pleasures, and pains.
Such variety supports the performance and fruition of action.
Therefore Kanya is a land of action.
inference: Because of its rich variety of life conditions, Kanya island is the supreme land of action.
plain_english: Because Kanya island contains a great variety of social orders, stages of life, conduct, pleasures, and pains, it is the supreme land of action.
